repair_phases.name: PRESERVE_AND_AUDIT
actions: Hash all 109 existing portfolio files -> repairs/pre-execution-file-hashes.json
Capture repository state -> reports/repository-state-before-execution.json
Create execution directory structure (20 dirs)
Write pre-execution-audit.json (12 findings)

repair_phases.name: RECONSTRUCT_SOURCE_TASKCARD_TRUTH
actions: Reread all 41 source plan files
Extract full source taskcard records with acceptance criteria, affected paths, prerequisites
Verify supplemented taskcard IDs for s003 s005 s010 s012 s015 s030 s038
Write source-taskcards/all-source-taskcards.json
Write source-taskcards/extraction-summary.json

repair_phases.name: INVESTIGATE_REPOSITORY_TRUTH
actions: Check actual validator count in governance_validator_runner.py
Verify plan_importer.py existence and state
Verify lifecycle_audit iteration loop
Check oracle assessment state for shiny-percolating-sky
Check agentic parity state for glimmering-hopping-kazoo
Assess repository implementation status for each canonical workstream

repair_phases.name: SPLIT_INTO_WORKSTREAMS_AND_EXECUTABLE_TASKS
actions: Group 1514 source taskcards into coherent workstreams (not plans)
Split each workstream into atomic executable tasks
Each executable task: single mutation scope, individual verifiable, retryable
Eliminate CT-025 (11 plans -> multiple executable tasks)
Eliminate CT-026 (broad product deepening -> multiple executable tasks)
Assign every source taskcard to exactly one executable task or proven disposition
Verify OVERBROAD_EXECUTABLE_TASKS = 0

repair_phases.name: REBUILD_PROVENANCE
actions: Bidirectional: source plan -> source taskcard -> executable task
Bidirectional: executable task -> source taskcards -> source requirements

Allowed dispositions: EXECUTE_TASK | SPLIT_ACROSS_TASKS | SATISFIED_BY_VERIFIED_EXISTING_IMPLEMENTATION | SUPERSEDED_WITH_PROOF | DUPLICATE_WITH_PROVEN_EQUIVALENCE | OUT_OF_SCOPE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION | BLOCKED_BY_TRUE_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY | REQUIRES_HUMAN_DECISION
Rebuild all 41 plan checklists from repaired mappings
Verify SOURCE_TASKCARDS_WITHOUT_DISPOSITION = 0

repair_phases.name: BUILD_CONTROLLER_AND_SCHEMAS
actions: Build portfolio_controller.py with all required commands
Create JSON schemas for all 21 artifact types
Create portfolio_validator.py
Write controller/README.md with exact commands
Test controller validate command

repair_phases.name: GENERATE_TASK_PACKETS
actions: One task packet per executable task
Each packet self-contained: no need to load all 41 plans
Includes: implementation_steps, acceptance_criteria, verification_requirements, evidence_requirements, rollback
Verify EXECUTABLE_TASKS_WITHOUT_PACKETS = 0

repair_phases.name: REBUILD_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH_AND_WAVES
actions: Rebuild at executable-task granularity
Verify no cycles
Rebuild waves: only dependency-satisfied tasks may be READY
Verify READY_TASKS_WITH_UNMET_DEPENDENCIES = 0

repair_phases.name: VALIDATE_ALL_COUNTERS
actions: Run portfolio_controller.py validate
Verify all 18 pre-execution required counters = 0
Approve execution start

repair_phases.name: EXECUTE
actions: Execute Wave 0 tasks in order
Each task: claim -> lock -> implement -> verify -> evidence -> close
Update source taskcards and plan checklists after each task
Run integration tests when eligible
Advance waves as predecessors complete

repair_phases.name: CLOSE_PLANS_AND_PORTFOLIO
actions: Reread each original plan before closing
Verify every original requirement and taskcard has final disposition
Write one closure record per plan
Run final reconciliation across all 41 plans
Write portfolio closure record

repair_complete_when: All R-01 through R-11 phases COMPLETE and all Section 22 counters = 0
